post.originalText:
Turned a simple beverage idea into a polished UGC-style product video using @Kling_ai MCP.

I created an influencer-style host to showcase a Mango Passionfruit beverage, complete with product presentation, narration, and background music — all from a simple workflow.

Instead of building each element separately, Kling MCP helped turn a basic concept into ready-to-use promotional content.

A practical example of how MCP can simplify the entire creative process from prompt to finished product video.

Prompt used:
“Create an e-commerce UGC talking-head video for this beverage. A young, influencer-style woman should appear on camera to showcase and introduce the product to an international audience. The flavor is Mango Passionfruit.”
